preparation_protocol.forbidden_reason: nonlinear embeddings can manufacture cluster structure and add hyperparameters, which would make the external claim uninterpretable
preparation_protocol.native_2d_policy: a dataset that is already exactly 2-D numeric is used as-is; scaling is still applied so all sources share one representation contract, and PCA is skipped
preparation_protocol.claim_wording: clustering of fixed unsupervised 2-D representations of real-world labelled datasets -- NOT recovery of universally true natural clusters

eligibility_real.reproducibly_obtainable: pinned OpenML data_id or sklearn bundled loader
eligibility_real.labelled: labels used only for curation and offline scoring

label_policy: labels are used ONLY to count classes for the 2<=K<=5 rule and for offline scoring after predictions are persisted; they never reach preparation or execution
outcome_free: no dataset was accepted or rejected on the basis of any clustering or model result; no method has been executed
